summary: Ticket queue CQRS ES with schedule quota and if-uri view

delivery.outcome: Closed POA ticketed process-queue pack: protobuf+JSON CQRS/ES, sequential schedule with dependencies, operation and twin-node quotas, if-uri catalog query, and analysis P0/P1 seed. RuntimeOwner stays subactor; no daemon and no Control restart.
nonGoals: Do not implement a scheduler daemon inside wellmanifest
Do not restart Control or mutate the dirty core bind-mount
Do not open a GitHub pull request
Do not ticket www-sub-actor 16 as needing founder approve
Do not touch doctor-hygiene, policy-dsl 4, ticket-077, skills-agent, platform deploy-missing-modules, or port 8780

architecture.decision: Adopt POA as the ticket/process-queue source of truth. Commands append events; ProcessQueueView and if-uri node list are queries. Queue adapter rejects enqueue without a registered inspectable ticket_id. Subactor planfile/doctor/control must read these tickets at runtime.
dataChanges: Introduce the closed poa.ticket/v1 process-queue, schedule, quota and view family
architecture.rollback: Remove the four new standard files and the conformance hook; existing POA v1 process contracts remain unchanged.
